description: This Java class 'InitializationDatabaseImpl' is part of the service layer responsible for populating and initializing reference data in the database, including languages, countries, zones, currencies, merchant stores, modules, and sub-references during application setup or migration.

classes.name: InitializationDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for initializing and populating core reference data in the database, including languages, countries, zones, currencies, merchant information, modules, and sub-references.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to trigger the population of reference data in the specified context.

methods.name: createLanguages
methods.description: Creates language entries based on predefined ISO codes.

methods.name: createCountries
methods.description: Creates country entries and their descriptions for supported locales.

methods.name: createZones
methods.description: Loads and creates geographic zones based on configuration files.

methods.name: createCurrencies
methods.description: Populates currency data based on Java Currency API and schema constants.

methods.name: createMerchant
methods.description: Creates a default merchant store with predefined settings and associations.

methods.name: createModules
methods.description: Loads and creates integration module configurations.

methods.name: createSubReferences
methods.description: Creates product type sub-references, primarily general product type.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the database has any language entries, indicating if the reference data is empty.
